Condition: Two privileged accounts lacked documented evidence of quarterly access review.
Criteria: Privileged access should be restricted to authorized personnel and periodically reviewed under company access management policy.
Risk and Potential Impact: Excessive or inappropriate privileged access may remain undetected and could permit unauthorized changes to financial systems or data.
Root Cause: Inadequate documentation and execution of periodic privileged access reviews.
Recommendation: Require quarterly privileged access reviews with documented reviewer sign-off, investigation of exceptions, and evidence of timely remediation.

Condition: One quarterly user access review lacked documented application owner sign-off.
Criteria: Application owners should perform and document periodic reviews of user access.
Risk and Potential Impact: Inappropriate user permissions may remain undetected, potentially affecting the confidentiality and integrity of financial reporting systems.
Recommendation: Require application owners to formally approve quarterly access reviews and retain supporting evidence.

Condition: Two sampled production changes lacked documented evidence of completed testing before deployment.
Criteria: Production changes should undergo documented testing and review before release.
Risk and Potential Impact: Untested changes may introduce errors into financial reporting applications, potentially affecting the accuracy and completeness of financial data.
Root Cause: Inadequate enforcement of change testing documentation requirements.
Recommendation: Require documented test plans, test results, and reviewer approval before production deployment, with controlled exceptions for emergencies.

Condition: One sampled emergency change lacked documented retrospective review evidence.
Criteria: Emergency changes should be documented and reviewed after implementation.
Risk and Potential Impact: Emergency changes may introduce unauthorized or untested modifications that affect financial reporting systems.
Root Cause: Retrospective review requirements were not consistently followed or documented.
Recommendation: Require retrospective reviews within a defined timeframe and escalate overdue reviews to the IT Change Manager.

Finding Title: Incomplete Investigation of Failed Financial Processing Jobs
Condition: Two sampled failed processing job executions lacked documented investigation and resolution evidence.
Criteria: Critical financial processing jobs should be monitored and failed executions investigated and resolved.
Risk and Potential Impact: Incomplete processing may result in missing or inaccurate financial data, potentially affecting financial reporting.
Root Cause: Insufficient monitoring follow-up and incident documentation.
Recommendation: Implement documented exception tracking, assign investigation owners, and require evidence of resolution before closure.

Condition: One recovery test identified a recovery-time objective failure that remained unresolved at year-end.
Criteria: Critical financial systems should have tested recovery arrangements and identified issues should be tracked to resolution.
Risk and Potential Impact: Extended system downtime could disrupt financial reporting activities and delay access to critical financial data.
Root Cause: Recovery capability gaps and insufficient remediation follow-up.
Recommendation: Develop a corrective action plan, assign accountable owners and target dates, and perform a successful follow-up recovery test.
